items.response: Yes to Hannah: Jun can come Saturday from 1 to 4. Have him turn the 10% into after-tax dollars per month and compare that to the time he'd get back, then weigh the things that matter more than either, like caseload, mentorship and room to grow. If those are about equal, I'd lean toward the clinic close to home. Action: Draft a short, friendly message to Marcus with those questions so you can send it or adjust it.

EFT (electronic funds transfer) is the general term for moving money electronically between accounts in Canada, which includes direct deposits and pre-authorized debits. ACH is the US name for its batch network; the nearest Canadian equivalent is the batch clearing system run by Payments Canada, so people often say ACH when they mean a Canadian EFT. Wires are a different, usually faster and pricier, rail for large one-off payments. Action: If it helps, I'll write a two-line glossary you can drop into your deck.

I also don't have any food notes on file for him, so please confirm any restrictions before Grace sends food. Action: Ask Leo or Sam for his current favourites, and once you have them I'll draft a reply to Grace with ideas and the food rules.

A common rule of thumb is that a cohort retention curve has flattened when the period-over-period drop falls to roughly 1 percentage point or less for several periods in a row, so the line is close to horizontal. It helps to also check it's a real plateau and not just small cohort noise. The exact threshold depends on your product and how fast the curve fell before. Action: If you want, send the cohort data and I'll check where it flattens.

Once it's signed we'll confirm the timeline, and we're happy to talk it through on a call. Best, Priya.' Pastel de nata comes from Portugal, from the Belém neighbourhood of Lisbon, where monks at the Jerónimos Monastery made custard tarts and sold them once the monastery needed money. A bakery nearby, Pastéis de Belém, still sells them using a recipe that is kept secret. Kid version: the monks used egg yolks left over from starching clothes with egg whites, so they made tarts. Action: None needed; I can find a short kid-friendly video or a recipe if Leo wants to try making them.

An EFT is a batch electronic transfer through the clearing system, typically cheap and taking a day or more, while a wire is a one-off, faster transfer for large amounts with higher fees and that is hard to reverse. For merchant payouts, EFT is the normal rail and wires are the exception, so sales should not use them interchangeably. Action: Write a one-line definition of each that you can paste into the deck to send to sales.
